overview.title: Overview
overview.description: This project is designed to assist enthusiastic learners in getting familiar with basic binary search tree and graph algorithms by letting the user animate them in an engaging way.

features.title: Features
list: Visualize BST (binary search tree) and Graph algorithms in your desired speed.
Complete your Registration to allow yourself to upload custom data to use in the system.
When creating your custom graph, you can add nodes, define if the graph should be directed or not, and add all your edges into the graph.
Nodes work similarly for custom binary search trees as well, after that, the system will generate all the other needed information for the tree.

myData.title: My Data
myData.description: Under the Data Structures section, you can manage uploaded or predefined graphs and trees by the system. View and explore your datasets.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: The goal of this tool is to make computer science concepts more approachable and engaging — especially for visual learners and algorithm enthusiasts.
vision.footer: Built with ❤️ and passion for CS students, teachers, and curious minds.

home.tagline: Visualize, learn, and master algorithms like never before. Our tools are designed to simplify complex concepts, making learning engaging and intuitive.
home.description: AlgoLearn provides a seamless experience for understanding graph and binary tree algorithms. Whether you're studying, preparing for interviews, or exploring for fun:

points.1: Browse preloaded graphs and trees to visualize their structures and workings.
points.2: Execute popular algorithms like BFS (Breadth-First Search), DFS (Depth-First Search), and more, with step-by-step visualization.
points.3: Create, customize, and save your own data structures to analyze and test scenarios.

viewGraphs.title: View Graphs and Trees
viewGraphs.desc: Explore a variety of preloaded graphs and understand their structures visually.

binaryAlgorithms.title: Binary Tree Algorithms
binaryAlgorithms.desc: Explore binary tree algorithms like insert, search, and sort with interactive visuals.

graphAlgorithms.title: Graph Algorithms
graphAlgorithms.desc: Dive into graph algorithms such as BFS and DFS with step-by-step visualizations.

why.title: Why Choose AlgoLearn?
why.desc: Our platform turns algorithm learning into an interactive journey. Whether you're mastering fundamentals or preparing for your next big interview, AlgoLearn provides a hands-on, intuitive experience tailored for all learners.
